product_metadata.title: Marco Almond® KYA28 Kitchen Knife Set, 14 Pieces Stainless Steel Cutlery Knives Sets for Kitchen with Block and Built-in Sharpener, Full Tang Knife Sets

【Value kitchen Knife Set】14 pieces knives sets for kitchen with block include: 1pc-8" chef knife, 1pc-8" slicing knife,1pc-5" santoku knife, 1pc-5.5" serrated utility knife, 1pc-5"utility knife, 1pc-3.5" paring knife, 6pcs 4.5" serrated steak knives, 1pc-all-purpose kitchen shear and 1pc-black wooden knife block.

【Ultra Sharp Knives set】Each forged kitchen knife features high-carbon Japanese stainless steel blade which ensure the knife retains its ultra-sharp edge and makes cutting through food easy. This cutlery kitchen knife set is tarnished, rust-resistant and can withstand high-frequency use or use after long periods of idle.

【Outstanding Performance】 Optimized weight and good balance make this kitchen block knife set fit nicely in the palm of hand. Exclusive taper grind edge technology provides optimum sharpness for precise cutting and is easy to re-sharpen. Fantastic set of knives give kitchen a neat, nice, clean, and organized look.

【Ideal Gift】This knife block set is a perfect and practical present for your parents, neighbors, weddings, housewarming,Thanksgiving, Christmas, birthdays, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, New Year, Valentine's Day, Easter or other special days. Home necessities for every family.
